# version_lifecycle_evidence

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

Executable lifecycle evidence binding an exact subject version to its enforced support horizon.

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |

| `supported_until` | `datetime` | yes | UTC instant through which the subject version is admitted for support. |
